planets.name: TOI-4666 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4666 with a 2.91-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-4666 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4666. Its orbit and size follow Dransfield et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
